description:
You are a LEED BD+C consultant performing an ASHRAE 90.1-2019 Energy Cost Budget compliance review for the L_Shape commercial office building. Your lighting power density (LPD) audit has revealed two categories of non-compliance:

1. Executive/private office spaces currently modeled at 1.3 W/ft² (LIGHTING-W/AREA = 1.3) exceed the ASHRAE 90.1-2019 Space-by-Space LPD allowance of 1.07 W/ft² for private offices. You must reduce LIGHTING-W/AREA from 1.3 to 1.05 W/ft² for ALL spaces currently set at this value.

2. Plug and process loads (EQUIPMENT-W/AREA) in those same office spaces are modeled at 1.5 W/ft², exceeding the client’s agreed plug-load management target. Reduce EQUIPMENT-W/AREA from 1.5 to 1.2 W/ft² for ALL spaces currently at 1.5 W/ft².

After making all LPD and equipment load corrections across all affected spaces (these appear on multiple floors), run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to compute the resulting reduction in lighting and equipment energy consumption. Save the project.

The L_Shape model is already loaded. You must independently navigate the Building Shell and Space activity definitions to find and update all non-compliant spaces. The number of affected spaces is not specified.

metadata.note: Spaces with LIGHTING-W/AREA=1.3 are private executive offices on upper floors of L_Shape
